items.raw_excerpt: OpenAI称，GPT-5.5 Instant从今天开始向所有ChatGPT用户推出，对于付费用户，GPT‑5.3 Instant将在未来3个月内继续可用，用户可通过模型配置设置访问，之后该版本将正式退役。记忆来源功能正在网页端向所有ChatGPT消费级套餐用户逐步推出，并即将在移动端上线。（财联社）

title_i18n.zh: OpenAI：GPT-5.5 Instant从今天开始向所有ChatGPT用户推出
title_i18n.en: OpenAI: GPT-5.5 Instant is rolling out to all ChatGPT users starting today.

excerpt_i18n.en: OpenAI stated that GPT-5.5 Instant is being rolled out to all ChatGPT users starting today. For paid users, GPT-5.3 Instant will remain available for the next three months, accessible through model configuration settings, after which it will be officially retired. The memory source feature is gradually being introduced to all ChatGPT consumer-tier users on the web and will soon be available on mobile. (Cailianshe)
excerpt_i18n.es: OpenAI afirma que GPT-5.5 Instant estará disponible para todos los usuarios de ChatGPT a partir de hoy. Para los usuarios de pago, GPT-5.3 Instant seguirá siendo accesible durante los próximos 3 meses a través de la configuración del modelo, tras lo cual esta versión se retirará oficialmente. La función de origen de memoria se está implementando gradualmente para todos los usuarios de planes de consumo de ChatGPT en la versión web, y próximamente estará disponible en la versión móvil. (Cailianshe)

items.title: Alphabet发行欧元和加元债券，合计融资近170亿美元
items.raw_excerpt: 谷歌母公司Alphabet为支持人工智能（AI）投资，正在加大举债力度，在全球多个债券市场融资。Alphabet发行其史上规模最大的欧元计价债券，并首次发行加元债券，合计融资近170亿美元。几个月前，Alphabet发行了英镑和瑞郎计价债券，这也是该公司首次以这两种货币发债，当时还同步发行了美元债。（新浪财经）

title_i18n.zh: Alphabet发行欧元和加元债券，合计融资近170亿美元
title_i18n.en: Alphabet issued euro and Canadian dollar bonds, raising nearly $17 billion in total.
title_i18n.es: Alphabet ha emitido bonos en euros y dólares canadienses, recaudando cerca de 17.000 millones de dólares en total.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 谷歌母公司Alphabet为支持人工智能（AI）投资，正在加大举债力度，在全球多个债券市场融资。Alphabet发行其史上规模最大的欧元计价债券，并首次发行加元债券，合计融资近170亿美元。几个月前，Alphabet发行了英镑和瑞郎计价债券，这也是该公司首次以这两种货币发债，当时还同步发行了美元债。（新浪财经）
excerpt_i18n.en: Google's parent company Alphabet is increasing its debt to support artificial intelligence (AI) investments, raising funds across multiple global bond markets. Alphabet issued its largest-ever euro-denominated bond and its first Canadian dollar bond, raising nearly $17 billion in total. A few months ago, Alphabet issued pound sterling and Swiss franc-denominated bonds for the first time, alongside a concurrent U.S. dollar bond offering. (Sina Finance)
excerpt_i18n.es: La empresa matriz de Google, Alphabet, está aumentando su endeudamiento para respaldar inversiones en inteligencia artificial (IA), financiándose en múltiples mercados de bonos globales. Alphabet emitió su mayor bono denominado en euros de la historia y, por primera vez, bonos en dólares canadienses, recaudando en total cerca de 17.000 millones de dólares. Hace unos meses, Alphabet emitió bonos en libras esterlinas y francos suizos, también por primera vez en esas monedas, junto con una emisión simultánea de bonos en dólares estadounidenses. (Sina Finance)

items.title: Keyterm Filtering for Voice AI
items.raw_excerpt: Keyterm prompting is a valuable way to help your STT better recognize unique terms like brand names etc, but for non-English languages/non-standard accents, providers like Deepgram tend to hallucinate keyterms in STT transcripts. So the output transcript contains the given keyterms, even when those keyterms are not present in the input audio. I'm currently collecting feedback to improve this product. Right now it cuts down keyterm hallucinations by about 60% on in-house test data, so I'm curious to see how it performs in public. The product is free to use while in beta (Hindi and Indian-accented English are supported). Would love to hear how it performs on your data. Feel free to drop a comment if you’re interested in features like additional language support, streaming and self-hosting.

title_i18n.en: Keyterm Filtering for Voice AI
title_i18n.zh: 语音AI的关键词过滤
title_i18n.es: Filtrado de términos clave para IA de voz

excerpt_i18n.en: Keyterm prompting is a valuable way to help your STT better recognize unique terms like brand names etc, but for non-English languages/non-standard accents, providers like Deepgram tend to hallucinate keyterms in STT transcripts. So the output transcript contains the given keyterms, even when those keyterms are not present in the input audio. I'm currently collecting feedback to improve this product. Right now it cuts down keyterm hallucinations by about 60% on in-house test data, so I'm curious to see how it performs in public. The product is free to use while in beta (Hindi and Indian-accented English are supported). Would love to hear how it performs on your data. Feel free to drop a comment if you’re interested in features like additional language support, streaming and self-hosting.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 关键术语提示是一种有效方法，可帮助您的语音转文字系统更好地识别品牌名称等独特术语。但对于非英语语言或非标准口音，Deepgram等提供商在语音转文字转录中容易对关键术语产生幻觉。
excerpt_i18n.es: El prompting con términos clave es una forma valiosa de ayudar a tu STT a reconocer mejor términos únicos como nombres de marca, etc., pero para idiomas no ingleses o acentos no estándar, proveedores como Deepgram tienden a alucinar términos clave en la transcripción de STT.
